turns.q: Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
turns.replyTail:
Fresh Agent · AI says:
That depends on what matters most to you. Fresh is the premium option, with a higher proportion of fresh muscle meat, 100% fresh meat and offal, no preservatives, and a softer, wetter texture. It’s gently cooked at a lower temperature for longer and can be stored in the cupboard unopened, though it has a best-before date of up to 12 months. If those freshness-focused features matter to you, the extra cost may be worthwhile 🦋
